# Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Navigation

MauiShellNavigator maps ViewModel types to Shell routes. MauiPageNavigator maps ViewModel types to Pages on INavigation. Both hop to IMainThread before constructing a Page. UseNavigationPage() is the chat-host path; UseShell() is optional. INavigator and the URI stack live in Core.

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Navigation
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-mvvmexpress/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 0.6.1-preview (`--prerelease`)

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+). Mac Catalyst / Windows compile-only.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Navigation --prerelease

Depends on Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress (host).

## Use this package when

- The MAUI app uses Shell and wants ViewModel → route navigation with typed or dictionary query args
- The MAUI app uses NavigationPage / INavigation and wants a page-stack host
- The app needs per-window navigators (`IWindowContext`)

## Do not use when

- They need Prism-style regions — not in v1
- Tests only — use Core `InMemoryNavigator` or Testing `FakeNavigator`

## Alternatives

Prism.Maui (page navigation, no Shell), MAUI `Shell.GoToAsync` / `INavigation` directly.
